title: Fixed Curved Heel Channel and Through Slot Shoehorn
description: One newly authored complete static shoehorn-style dressing prop. One uninterrupted thin body widens into a shallow transversely concave heel channel, narrows through a long curved neck and finishes in a short raised handle end with one real bounded through slot. The complete upper and lower surfaces, blunt finite perimeter and all four slot walls belong to one continuous closed editable mesh. The widened front remains an open channel, not a deep closed bowl or perforated shovel pan. Its warm constant opaque plastic-looking PBR material is untextured. All original numerical geometry newly authored, no old scoop handle, shoe block, cutter bed or imported part used. Metres Z up, horizontal bounds-centred ground datum, one whole model zero scenes. Unlike a split shoe stretcher there are no forefoot blocks, heel block or screw; unlike the prior pet-care slotted scoop there is no multi-slot shovel pan or raised return-loop handle. Empty static retail-dressing art only: no shoe, heel, foot, human fit, sizing, flex, aid to movement, use performance, strength, manufacture or safety capability. Rigging animation and interaction not made.
